name: Stakes
source:
Stakes is a wrestling themed adult visual novel set in world where wrestling is both the biggest sport and the most popular form of entertainment. But there's not just regular wrestling, there's also stake wrestling. A mixture between a wrestling match followed by a live sex show, stake wrestling is a match type where the winner has sex with the loser's 'stake' - a stake most of the time being a sexual performer or other wrestler.

You take control of the main character as he works his way up in this world of wrestling. He's got a bit of a chip on his shoulder and feels like he has something to prove, so he's more than eager to get started. What about you?

[From [url=https://kayfabe-octopus.itch.io/stakes-a-wrestling-avn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Stakes》是一部以摔跤为主题的成人视觉小说，背景设定在摔跤既是最大型运动也是最受欢迎的娱乐形式的世界中。但这里不仅有常规摔跤，还有木桩摔跤。木桩摔跤是摔跤比赛和现场性爱表演的混合体，是一种比赛类型，获胜者与失败者的“木桩”发生性关系——木桩大多数时候是性表演者或其他摔跤手。

你可以控制主角，让他在这个摔跤世界中不断进步。他心里有些不安，觉得自己有东西要证明，所以他非常渴望开始。你呢？

[来自[url=https://kayfabe-octopus.itch.io/stakes-a-wrestling-avn]Itch.io[/url]]
